test_title: PYST 41: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

While I was teaching the elder one, __the younger one take an opportunity and ran away.__

options.text: the younger one took an opportunity and ran away
the younger one will take an opportunity and ran away
the younger one has taken an opportunity and ran away

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. the younger one took an opportunity and ran away.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the past continuous tense, as indicated by **"While I was teaching"**.
 
• In this context, the action performed by the younger one (taking the opportunity and running away) must also be in the past tense to maintain consistency with the sentence structure.
 
• The correct past tense of "take" is "took," so the appropriate substitution is "the younger one took an opportunity and ran away."

Correct sentence: *While I was teaching the elder one, the younger one **took an opportunity and ran away**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Past Continuous Tense:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + was/were + verb(-ing) + object.
 
• **Usage:** Describes an action that was ongoing at a specific time in the past.
 
• **Example:** I was reading a book when the phone rang.
 
 
 
• **Simple Past Tense:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + past form of the verb + object.
 
• **Usage:** Describes actions that were completed in the past.
 
• **Example:** She took a deep breath and started speaking.
